xBRIEFInfo.author: overdeck/0.0.0
xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-5503: docs: accuracy audit, Configuration (21 pages)

metadata.sizeJustification: Every item edits one Mintlify page in the single configuration/ directory; the finalize lint counts each configuration/<page>.mdx as its own subsystem, so 23 pages read as 23 subsystems. The epic (#5467) scopes one audit issue per docs nav group, and the pages share one validation pass and one PR body, so splitting into sibling issues would duplicate the validator and PR-body work without adding review isolation.

narratives.Problem: The 23 pages in the Configuration docs nav group contain wrong, stale and removed claims: wrong config keys (providerHarnesses), removed features (live harness switching, off-book dispatch, service templates, releaseStatus, project-mappings), reversed behavior (Anthropic auth mode), stub features presented as supported (GitLab issues), and hundreds of en/em dashes that the style rule bans.
narratives.Proposal: The planning session audited all 23 pages against code and recorded every finding with grep anchor, replacement text and evidence in .pan/drafts/PAN-5503.md. One docs item per page (harnesses.mdx split into four section items chained by blocks edges because they share a file) applies the change table, the residual rule, the dash rule, the frontmatter rule and the link check. A final item runs lint:docs and the Mintlify validators and writes the per-page PR body with Follow-ups for code bugs.
narratives.NonGoals:
- No code, test, rule, docs.json, CLAUDE.md, README.md or changelog.d change; code bugs found go to the PR body's Follow-ups
- No edits to pages outside the Configuration nav group (the Anywhere pages under configuration/ belong to #5500)
- No new pages, navigation changes, file renames or slug changes
- No heading renames; a heading is deleted only where the PRD says so
- No screenshots or images added or replaced
- No restoring configuration/state-branch.mdx

autoDecisions.summary: Audit the 23 pages in the Configuration nav group, not only the 21 listed in the issue
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue's scope sentence is every published page in the group; state-branch.mdx was retired by PAN-5472 and model-routing, docs-rag and progressive-polyrepo are in the group but in no sibling audit issue.

autoDecisions.summary: For state-branch.mdx, only verify the PAN-5472 redirect and that no group page links it
autoDecisions.rationale: The file no longer exists on main; PAN-5472 replaced it with a redirect to /reference/state-model.

autoDecisions.summary: Add Discord and GitHub Issues links only to pages with troubleshooting or help sections
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue asks for the links where a page talks about getting help; adding a help section to every page is not requested.

autoDecisions.summary: Retitle generic titles and keep the old title as sidebarTitle
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue asks for specific searchable titles; sidebarTitle keeps the navigation labels short, matching docs-rag.mdx.

autoDecisions.summary: Describe current code behavior where code is buggy and list the bug as a Follow-up
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue is docs-only; describing intended behavior as current would reintroduce inaccuracy.

autoDecisions.summary: Split harnesses.mdx into four section items chained by blocks edges
autoDecisions.rationale: The page is 1,522 lines with 48 findings; section items stay reviewable, and the edges serialize the shared-file edits.
